FinalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one wide 16:9 blog hero banner, no text or typography. Reference photos are identity references only for the same middle-aged woman, not composition targets: retain her recognizable face, fair skin, blue-grey eyes, long silver-grey wavy hair and sturdy broad-shouldered feminine build. Dress her in a fitted dark professional blazer over a black tech-casual top, sleeves pushed up, subtle magenta makeup. Scene: a quiet futuristic textile atelier, cyberpunk/tech-noir high-detail cinematic digital painting with believable materials. A monumental partially woven tapestry fills most of the picture, stretched on a sleek loom, tilted in perspective so both its beautiful front and interwoven depth are visible. She stands beside it at left, three-quarter profile, thoughtful focused expression, naturally using a small weaving shuttle to adjust one luminous amber thread. The tapestry is the main subject. Its upper woven pattern subtly depicts a customer's route across three small abstract interface panels including a signup form with blank input shapes; no words, no logos. Those shapes are woven into the textile itself, not floating screens. Continuous cyan, magenta, silver and amber warp and weft threads visibly connect this surface journey to deeper geometric motifs of branching rules and interconnected system structures lower in the SAME textile. Show several unfinished translucent sections and loose but orderly strands at its edge, suggesting a provisional design whose supporting layers are being resolved together. The thread she touches can be visually traced through multiple motifs, with a soft amber pulse propagating across the weave; everything belongs to one coherent woven whole. Rich tactile fibers, precise interlacing, substantial cloth, elegant craft rather than a glowing computer dashboard. Dark charcoal and midnight-blue atelier, cyan and magenta thread glow with restrained warm amber accents, gentle screenlike illumination on face, silver rim lighting in hair, atmospheric depth. Medium-wide composition, tapestry dominates center and right, face and tapestry occupy central crop-safe band; detailed without visual clutter. Mood: analytical, capable, contemplative. Avoid disconnected waterfall tiers, tangled chaos, robots, extra people, readable code, UI labels, title lettering, watermarks, generic floating hologram cards, glamor poses. Output wide landscape 16:9.
